description: Land Acquisition - Uduwa West, Galbada and Uduwa East, Thihagoda D/S Division, Matara District - Amendment to the notice published in Gaz. Ex. Ord. No. 1931/20 of 09.09.2015 by Weeraketiya D/S Division
reasoning: This gazette content is exclusively about land acquisition notices under the Land Acquisition Act. It provides detailed descriptions of specific parcels of land being acquired by the government for public purposes, including lot numbers, land names, descriptions, claimants, and exact measurements. This falls squarely under Type 4 (Land Gazettes) which covers land acquisitions, transfers, and property-related matters.
